fine_lines.title: I just ran vs I've just found
fine_lines.explanation_ar: just تعني «للتو». في الإنجليزية البريطانية نستخدمها مع المضارع التام: I've just found my new goal. وفي الأمريكية يُقال أيضًا مع الماضي البسيط: I just ran from over there. الشكلان صحيحان في الأمريكية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Just" means "a very short time ago". British English uses it with the present perfect: I've just found my new goal. American English also uses it with the past simple: I just ran from over there. Both are fine in American English.

fine_lines.title: raise money vs make money
fine_lines.explanation_ar: raise money = تجمع المال من الناس لهدف خيري أو جيد. make money = تكسب المال لنفسك من العمل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Raise money" = collect money from people for a good cause. "Make money" = earn money for yourself from work.

examples.sentence: The school is raising money for sick children.
He makes money by fixing cars.

fine_lines.title: I will vs I just might
fine_lines.explanation_ar: will للتأكد من المستقبل: I will run in my first marathon. might للاحتمال (ربما): I just might win!
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Will" is for things you are sure about in the future: I will run in my first marathon. "Might" is for things that are possible: I just might win!

examples.sentence: This weekend, I will run in my first marathon.

grammar.title: Present perfect continuous: How long have you been …?
grammar.explanation_ar:
نسأل عن مدة نشاط بدأ في الماضي ولا يزال مستمرًا بـ: How long have/has + الفاعل + been + الفعل + ing?
• How long have you been training?
• I've been training for an hour.
ونجيب بـ for + مدة (for an hour, for a week) أو since + بداية (since this morning).
grammar.explanation_en:
To ask about how long an activity has been going on, use: How long have/has + subject + been + verb-ing?
• How long have you been training?
• I've been training for an hour.
Answer with for + a period (for an hour, for a week) or since + a starting point (since this morning).
examples: How long have you been training?
I've been training for an hour and seven minutes.
She has been running since she was ten.
How long has he been waiting?

grammar.title: Present perfect with just
grammar.explanation_ar: have/has + just + التصريف الثالث = حدث للتو، قبل وقت قصير جدًا. I've just found my new goal. ضع just بين have والتصريف الثالث.
grammar.explanation_en: have/has + just + past participle = it happened a very short time ago. I've just found my new goal. Put "just" between have/has and the past participle.
examples: I've just found my new goal.
She has just finished the race.

questions.question: Complete: "I've been training ___ an hour."

questions.explanation_en: Use "for" with a period of time.
